post_frozen_claim_ceiling.interpretation: The frozen G2 evidence validates information-guided candidate screening over random order. It does not provide material empirical evidence that adaptive recomputation outperforms a static initial-information ranking on these benchmark systems.
post_frozen_claim_ceiling.adaptive_recomputation_claim: Conditional theorem only: V_adapt >= V_static, with strict advantage when no candidate is branchwise optimal on every positive-probability branch; this is not a global greedy-optimality claim.

science_freeze_policy: Any change to G2 scientific parameters, observation-information semantics, adaptive-recomputation theorem content, frozen numerical claims or distributed package source requires a new protocol/version or intentional G5 artifact freeze. A text-only change to the review manuscript requires a refreshed anonymous reviewer bundle but does not by itself require a new G5 freeze. Metadata-only readiness/title-page updates do not supersede artifact_validation_sha.
